description: This file contains a helper class 'FieldIdAssignmentHelper' used for assigning and managing field IDs for serialization within the Orleans code generator. It deals with generating IDs based on annotations or implicit rules, and supports reflection on symbols, properties, and fields for serialization purposes.

classes.name: FieldIdAssignmentHelper
classes.description: A helper class that assigns and manages field identifiers for serialization, supporting explicit annotations and implicit ID generation based on property and constructor parameters.

methods.name: TryGetSymbolKey
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the ID key and its associated boolean flag for a given symbol.

methods.name: HasMemberWithIdAnnotation
methods.description: Checks if any member has an annotation specifying its ID.

methods.name: GetMembers
methods.description: Retrieves serializable members (fields or properties) of a type, excluding static, abstract, or explicitly non-serialized members.

methods.name: ExtractFieldIdAnnotations
methods.description: Extracts field IDs from explicit annotations present on members, or prepares for implicit ID generation if annotations are absent.

methods.name: GetCanonicalNameAndFieldId
methods.description: Generates a canonical name and a hash-based field ID for a given type and name.

methods.name: GenerateImplicitFieldIds
methods.description: Generates implicit field IDs based on property names and constructor parameters, ensuring no hash collisions.
